capabilities: Color cells with fills, text colors, and conditional rules, data bars, and icon sets
Compute formulas using 49 Excel functions with a formula bar and live recalculation
Sort and filter rows with AutoFilter funnels stored in the note
Fill, copy, paste, and select cells with Excel keyboard shortcuts and a fill handle
Import and export tables as CSV or Excel rows
extras: README includes a limitations section, a security self-report (no network requests, no eval, clipboard use only on explicit commands), and lists sibling 'Power Plugins' by the same author. Notes stay plain Markdown: uninstalling degrades colors to text highlights.
problem: Obsidian tables are plain Markdown with no cell formatting, calculation, sorting, filtering, or spreadsheet-style selection and editing.
summary: Spreadsheet layer for Markdown tables: cell colors, Excel-style formulas, sorting, AutoFilter, and number formats, all stored as plain Markdown.
